answer: Admission auctions block bulk fake identities. Each new vertex bids for one of 50 slots per epoch; losers lose only a 2 POA fee. A public randomness beacon closes bidding and audits 10 winners, so timing cannot be gamed. Winners lock 200 POA for 20 epochs and whisper signed heartbeats to neighbours. Forging 1,000 identities costs 202,000 POA for a 50,000 POA pool, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays once and shares an undiluted pool.
